invariants: Only explicitly allowlisted GitHub actors may use the operator console.
The operator console is never published to GitHub Pages.
Workflow reruns use only fixed allowlisted workflow files on main.
Queue cancellation may only transition an existing QUEUED or ACTIVE scheduler work item to CANCELLED.
Persistent kill-switch and budget changes are proposed on a branch and pull request; the console never bypasses main branch review or CI.
Emergency stop may cancel currently queued/in-progress managed autonomy but does not silently rewrite persistent policy.
No operator-console operation sends customer communications, moves money, trades, changes secrets, or exposes private payloads.
